description: Looks up a company live in the official national company register of Norway (Brønnøysund Enhetsregisteret), Czechia (ARES), Finland (PRH / YTJ) or the United Kingdom (Companies House), by company number or by name (at most 10 matches). Returns name, legal form, address, registration date, state as the register says it ("active" only where the register says so, "registered" = entered and not deleted, "deleted", "ceased"), bankruptcy, liquidation or restructuring as separate fields where the register publishes them, and whether the company is VAT registered (true, false, or null if the register says nothing). Each field appears only if the register provides it. A name search can also return sole traders under a personal name, as the register publishes them. Use it to confirm that a Norwegian, Czech, Finnish or British partner exists and is active. "deleted" means the register shows a deletion, removal or end. "ceased" means the register says the legal unit has ceased. Finland: the Trade Register says "Ceased" (Lakannut); the entry stays in the register.

country.description: NO (Norway), CZ (Czechia), FI (Finland) or GB (United Kingdom).

name.description: Company name to search for (at most 10 matches). Give number OR name.

number.description: The national company number: NO organisation number (9 digits), CZ IČO (8 digits), FI Business ID / Y-tunnus (e.g. 0112038-9), GB company number (8 characters, e.g. 02050399 or SC002180). Give number OR name.

name: check_company_register
title: Check national company register
